i18n.zh-Hans: 模块名称的规范。
i18n.en-US: The specification of module name.

i18n.zh-Hans: 模块描述的规范。
i18n.en-US: The specification of module description.

cidr_block.description: The cidr block used to launch a new vpc.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动新VPC的CIDR块。
i18n.en-US: The CIDR block used to launch a new VPC.

image_id.description: The image id used to launch one or more ecs instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动一个或多个ECS实例的镜像ID。
i18n.en-US: The image id used to launch one or more ECS instances.

instance_type.description: The instance type used to launch one or more ecs instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动一个或多个 ECS 实例的实例类型。
i18n.en-US: The instance type used to launch one or more ECS instances.

host_name.description: Host name used on all instances as prefix. Like if the value is TF-ECS-Host-Name and then the final host name would be TF-ECS-Host-Name001, TF-ECS-Host-Name002 and so on.

i18n.zh-Hans: 在所有实例中用作前缀的主机名。例如，如果值为TF-ECS-Host-Name，那么最终的主机名将是TF-ECS-Host-Name001、TF-ECS-Host-Name002等。
i18n.en-US: Host name used on all instances as prefix. For example, if the value is TF-ECS-Host-Name, then the final host names would be TF-ECS-Host-Name001, TF-ECS-Host-Name002, and so on.

i18n.zh-Hans: 实例的密码。
i18n.en-US: The password of instance.

kms_encrypted_password.description: An KMS encrypts password used to an instance. It is conflicted with 'password'.

i18n.zh-Hans: An KMS加密了用于实例的密码。它与'password'冲突。
i18n.en-US: An KMS encrypts password used for an instance. It conflicts with 'password'.

kms_encryption_context.description: An KMS encryption context used to decrypt 'kms_encrypted_password' before creating or updating an instance with 'kms_encrypted_password'.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于在创建或更新实例之前解密'kms_encrypted_password'的KMS加密上下文。
i18n.en-US: An KMS encryption context used to decrypt 'kms_encrypted_password' before creating or updating an instance with 'kms_encrypted_password'.

system_disk_category.description: The system disk category used to launch one or more ecs instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动一个或多个ECS实例的系统磁盘类别。
i18n.en-US: The system disk category used to launch one or more ECS instances.

system_disk_size.description: The system disk size used to launch one or more ecs instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动一个或多个ECS实例的系统盘大小。
i18n.en-US: The system disk size used to launch one or more ECS instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 配置实例私有IP地址。
i18n.en-US: Configure Instance private IP address.

internet_max_bandwidth_out.description: The maximum internet out bandwidth of instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: 实例的最大互联网出带宽。
i18n.en-US: The maximum internet out bandwidth of instance.

associate_public_ip_address.description: Whether to associate a public ip address with an instance in a VPC.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否将公共 IP 地址与 VPC 中的实例关联。
i18n.en-US: Whether to associate a public IP address with an instance in a VPC.

instance_charge_type.description: The charge type of instance. Choices are 'PostPaid' and 'PrePaid'.

i18n.zh-Hans: 实例的计费类型。可选值为'PostPaid'和'PrePaid'。
i18n.en-US: The charge type of instance. Choices are 'PostPaid' and 'PrePaid'.

user_data.description: User data to pass to instance on boot.

i18n.zh-Hans: 引导时传递给实例的用户数据。
i18n.en-US: User data to pass to instance on boot.

role_name.description: Instance RAM role name. The name is provided and maintained by RAM. You can use 'alibabacloudstack_ram_role' to create a new one.

i18n.zh-Hans: 实例RAM角色名称。名称由RAM提供并维护。您可以使用'alibabacloudstack_ram_role'创建一个新的。
i18n.en-US: Instance RAM role name. The name is provided and maintained by RAM. You can use 'alibabacloudstack_ram_role' to create a new one.

key_name.description: The name of SSH key pair that can login ECS instance successfully without password. If it is specified, the password would be invalid.

i18n.zh-Hans: 可以成功无密码登录ECS实例的SSH密钥对名称。如果指定了此项，则密码将无效。
i18n.en-US: The name of the SSH key pair that can log into the ECS instance without a password. If specified, the password will be invalid.

i18n.zh-Hans: 安全增强策略。
i18n.en-US: The security enhancement strategy.

subscription.description: A mapping of fields for Prepaid ECS instances created.

i18n.zh-Hans: 已创建预付费ECS实例的字段映射。
i18n.en-US: A mapping of fields for Prepaid ECS instances created.

subscription.default:
{
    period             = 1
    period_unit        = "Month"
    renewal_status     = "Normal"
    auto_renew_period  = 1
    include_data_disks = true
  }

tags.description: A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.

i18n.zh-Hans: 要分配给资源的标签映射。
i18n.en-US: A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.

image_name_regex.description: The regex string used to search image launch one or more ecs instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于搜索镜像以启动一个或多个 ECS 实例的正则表达式字符串。
i18n.en-US: The regex string used to search for launching one or more ECS instances.

availability_zone.description: The available zone to launch ecs instance and other resources.

i18n.zh-Hans: 可用区用于启动ECS实例和其他资源。
i18n.en-US: The available zone to launch ECS instance and other resources.
